title: 第17章 横财第18章 浮光掠影
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 那么此刻就是收获胜利果实的时候，孙冰深深的望了一眼逐渐远去李力的背影，目光中透着同情，转身便朝着来的方向走去。
因为距离并不远，所以不消片刻便已经来到了此处，毕竟时间短暂，就算这里属于横断山脉的外围，但还没有被外人发现，当即，孙冰就开始细细搜索起来。
首先地上的三柄精铁利剑被他收了起来，然后在孙冰满怀期待的目光中，缓缓消失在那小小的剑匣前，虽然小剑匣的变化依旧不大，只是继续加黑加重了一点，但是孙冰的脸上充满了信心。
唯一可惜的就是那柄刀这剑匣不吞噬，这让孙冰相当遗憾，因此只能舍弃。
到目前为止，这些小罗罗身上已经毫无价值了，毕竟他们实力弱小，哪怕是收到了淬体丹的奖赏，要么以最快的速度服用，要么转卖，一柄兵器就是最大的财产，根本就没有别的宝物了。
当即，孙冰立刻朝着卢健的尸身走去，他作为一个头目，其价值远超常人。
最后的结果让孙冰相当惊喜，虽然对方的怀中仅仅只有一瓶丹药，但是里面足足蕴含了十二颗淬体丹，这也就意味着相当于孙冰四个月的分量，可真不是一个小数目了。
确认再也没有多余的价值后，孙冰立刻转身就走，毕竟此地乃是横断山脉的外围，经常性的有人经过，更何况此刻的孙冰已经是强弩之末，虽然现在还能够行走，但也经不起一番大战了。
而能来这里的人，眼中大多只剩下利益，就算是其余两大家族的弟子前来，也丝毫不介意手下他的人头，增加一点收获，所以此地不宜久留。
正好刚刚那个地方人迹罕至，而且还能防止李力从中逃跑，完全就是一个好去处，当即，孙冰立刻拖着有些无力的身体缓缓前行，至于地上的尸身，横断山脉中的野兽妖兽不少，到时候由它们处理，。
不多时，孙冰便已经到了地方，小心翼翼的查看一下四周，确认没有危险之后，这才缓缓坐下，虽然身体中毫无力气，但这正是修炼的好时机。
因为力竭，所以此时修炼不仅能恢复自身，就算是修炼得到的力量，也能完美的融合在一起，当即，孙冰立刻取出一枚淬体丹。
“当真是人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥啊。”
再一次轻轻感叹一句，孙冰立刻服下了丹药，伴随着药力的爆发，整个人的力气也缓缓的恢复了。
约莫半个时辰后，孙冰的双眼猛地一睁开，闪出一道精光，他能确定，此刻的自己比先前又强上了不少，感受到体内蓬勃的力量，这让孙冰那张严肃的面孔上也不由得露出了一丝笑容。
今天的这两场厮杀虽然危险横生，甚至一不小心都有可能陨落，但是他得到的相当多，第一场与斑斓蛇的厮杀，获得了珍贵的天材地宝朱果，至于第二场，又得到了那么多淬体丹。
更何况就算不谈这些外物，两场战斗让他完全掌控了此时身体的力量，每一次出招都蕴含了百分之百的力道，不会有丝毫浪费，而且根基扎实，这也为他接下来的进阶奠定了基础。
战斗中也收获了很多经验，其中包括对敌经验，对于人性的掌控，甚至对剑法的感悟也更深了，同时也感觉到了自己的不足，现在手中的招式终归是少了点，最主要的是，孙冰感觉自己缺少一门步法秘籍。
若是拥有步法的话，今天也就不至于这么被动了，想要进行追赶也无需花费这么多的时间，但可惜的是，孙冰根本就没有途径获得步法。
孙家的功法殿中可能拥有，但孙冰并没有在第一层看见，就算是有，他也完全没有资格进去观看，而那些散修，有一本残缺的秘籍就相当不错了，怎么可能随意挑选。
这让孙冰不由得长长叹了一口气，未来的道路终究还是很长的，孙冰坚信，这些东西他都将获得。
感觉到自己已经彻底恢复了，孙冰的目光朝着树林深处望去，虽然已经认定李力绝对十死无生，但终究还是亲眼看到比较好，孙冰可不想在未来碰到对方，万一运气不好就是陨落。
当即，挥了挥手中的木剑，感受着自己的力量，一人一剑朝着树林深处走去，在这个环境中，就算是他也不由得小心谨慎。
说实话，孙冰自己都纳闷，自己第一次是怎么进去的，一路上根本就没有碰到什么危险，仿佛自然而然的就过去了，反倒是半途之中碰到了斑斓蛇，然后返回的时候又撞到了五彩蛛。
因为有了防备，所以一路上便能够看到一些不同，例如有些树木上已经有这些毒物，但对方竟然没有攻击的意图，似乎想要放你进去一样。
这让孙冰不由得打了个寒颤，现在的毒物都这么聪明了么？这完全就是一个陷阱啊，首先让猎物感觉毫无危险进入，然后进行包围，这样最中央的猎物就成为了瓮中之鳖，想要逃都跑不掉，孙冰不由得有些头皮发麻。
当即，为了自己的安全，一路走过去一路清扫，那些斑斓蛇，五彩蛛就算毒性强大，可防御实在是有些低下，基本一剑扫过，全部毙命。
不知不觉中，孙冰已经来到了采集朱果的位置，当下嘴角一笑，因为不远处正有着一道人影趴着，看其服装，很明显就是已经逃跑的李力。
果然一如孙冰的猜测，哪怕对方是一个经验老道的猎手，但在斑斓蛇的围攻之下，根本就没有反击的能力，毕竟他所擅长的是远攻，而不是群攻。
缓缓走过去，只见此刻的李力双眼紧闭，脸上一片乌黑，很显然已经身中剧毒，此刻就算是解毒药在手，也毫无生机了。
这让孙冰一声感叹：修士一途果真是蕴含无数艰险，还有无数磨难，若是有一道没有跨过去，那么就意味着死亡，这可不是什么游戏，一旦死亡就再也没有任何机会了。
确认对方已经死亡，那么孙冰的目的便已经达到了，甚至就想要转身就走，可是突然间瞧见，对方的怀中竟然隐隐鼓起，似乎又什么东西似得。
这让孙冰产生了兴趣，不过望了望对方那乌黑的脸庞，还是有些心有余悸，斑斓蛇，五彩蛛这样的妖兽，孙冰倒是不害怕，但是它们的毒性就算是练气境高手都避之不及。
当下小心翼翼的将自己的木剑伸出，还真别说，经过了十年的打磨，木剑比之一般的精铁利剑也是不差分毫，那一层衣服竟然宛若豆腐一般就被切开，露出了里面的真容。
并没有如同孙冰想象中的是什么剧毒之物，反而用着一张褐色的兽皮包裹着，其中似乎潜藏着什么。
这副场景就让孙冰嘴角露出一丝笑容。似乎今天还有着另外的收入，虽然心中稍微有些激动，但却没有冲动，在剧毒环绕的树林中，必须保持绝对的冷静。
木剑缓缓的挪了挪，发现没有任何毒物出现，这才让孙冰松了一口气，缓缓过去把兽皮捡起，毫不犹豫的便将其打开，顿时脸上露出惊喜的笑容。
甚至他突破淬体四层都没有如此高兴过，兽皮之中包裹着一个小小的瓶子，其中装着的正是淬体丹，只不过这一瓶完全没有卢健那一瓶多，只有三颗罢了，聊胜于无吧。
让孙冰狂喜的则是另外一个收获，这正是一本书籍形状的物品，尤其是封面上写着四个大字《浮光掠影》，很明显，这就是传说中的步法秘籍。
content_en:
Then now was the time to reap the fruits of victory. Sun Bing took a deep look at Li Li's back, which was gradually moving away. With sympathy in his eyes, he turned around and walked in the direction he came from.
Because the distance was not far, it took only a moment to arrive here. After all, the time was short. Even though this place was on the outskirts of the Hengduan Mountains, it had not been discovered by outsiders. Immediately, Sun Bing began to search carefully.
First, he put away the three sharp iron swords on the ground, and then slowly disappeared in front of the small sword box under Sun Bing's expectant eyes. Although the small sword box still did not change much, it just continued to darken and become a little heavier, Sun Bing's face was full of confidence.
The only pity is that the sword and the sword case cannot be swallowed, which makes Sun Bing very regretful, so he can only give it up.
So far, these little Luo Luo are worthless. After all, they are weak. Even if they receive the body tempering pill as a reward, they must either take it as quickly as possible or resell it. A weapon is their greatest asset, and there is no other treasure at all.
Immediately, Sun Bing walked towards Lu Jian's body. As a leader, his value far exceeded that of ordinary people.
The final result surprised Sun Bing. Although there was only a bottle of pills in the other party's arms, it contained twelve body tempering pills. This meant that it was equivalent to four months of Sun Bing's weight, which was really not a small amount.
After confirming that there was no more extra value, Sun Bing immediately turned around and left. After all, this place was on the outskirts of the Hengduan Mountains, and people often passed by. What's more, Sun Bing was already at the end of his strength. Although he could still walk now, he could not withstand a big battle.
Most of the people who can come here only have interests in their eyes. Even if the disciples of the other two major families come, they don't mind his head at all to increase their harvest, so it is not suitable to stay here for a long time.
It happened that the place just now was inaccessible, and it could prevent Li Li from escaping. It was a good place. Immediately, Sun Bing immediately dragged his somewhat weak body forward slowly. As for the corpses on the ground, there were many beasts and monsters in the Hengduan Mountains. They would deal with them when the time came.
Not long after, Sun Bing arrived at the place. He carefully checked his surroundings and after confirming that there was no danger, he slowly sat down. Although there was no strength in his body, this was a good time to practice.
Because he was exhausted, not only could he recover himself through cultivation at this time, but even the power obtained through cultivation could be perfectly integrated. Immediately, Sun Bing took out a body tempering pill.
"It is true that a man cannot be rich without windfall, and a horse cannot be fat without night grass."
With another sigh, Sun Bing immediately took the elixir. With the explosion of the medicine's power, his strength slowly recovered.
About half an hour later, Sun Bing's eyes suddenly opened, and there was a flash of light. He was sure that he was much stronger than before. He felt the vigorous power in his body, which made Sun Bing's serious face reveal a smile.
Although today's two fights were dangerous, and he might even die if he was not careful, he gained quite a lot. In the first fight with the colorful snake, he got the precious treasures of heaven and earth, Zhu Fruit, and in the second fight, he got so many body tempering pills.
What's more, even if we don't talk about these external objects, the two battles have allowed him to completely control the power of his body at this time. Every move contains 100% of the power, without any waste, and has a solid foundation, which also laid the foundation for his next advancement.
He also gained a lot of experience in the battle, including experience against enemies, control over human nature, and even a deeper understanding of swordsmanship. At the same time, he also felt his own shortcomings. The moves in his hands were missing after all. The most important thing was that Sun Bing felt that he lacked a footwork secret.
If he had the footwork, he would not be so passive today, and he would not need to spend so much time catching up. But unfortunately, Sun Bing had no way to obtain the footwork.
The Sun family's Kung Fu Palace may have it, but Sun Bing didn't see it on the first floor. Even if it did, he was not qualified to go in and watch it. For those casual cultivators, it would be quite good to have a incomplete secret book, so how could they choose it at will.
This made Sun Bing sigh. After all, the road to the future is still very long. Sun Bing firmly believes that he will obtain all these things.
Feeling that he had completely recovered, Sun Bing looked deep into the woods. Although he had determined that Li Li was absolutely dead, it was better to see it with his own eyes. Sun Bing didn't want to meet him in the future. If he was unlucky, he would perish.
Immediately, he waved the wooden sword in his hand, feeling his own strength, and walked towards the depths of the woods with one sword and one man. In this environment, even he couldn't help but be cautious.
To be honest, Sun Bing himself was wondering how he got in for the first time. He didn't encounter any danger at all along the way. It seemed that he passed by naturally. Instead, he encountered a colorful snake on the way, and then bumped into a colorful spider when he returned.
Because you are on guard, you can see some differences along the way. For example, some trees already have these poisons on them, but the other party has no intention of attacking, as if they want to let you in.
This made Sun Bing shudder. Are all poisons so smart now? This is completely a trap. First, let the prey feel that there is no danger when entering, and then surround it. In this way, the prey in the center becomes a turtle in the urn, unable to escape even if it wants to escape. Sun Bing can't help but feel a little numb.
Immediately, for my own safety, I walked over and cleaned them all the way. Even though those colorful snakes and colorful spiders were very poisonous, their defense was really low. Basically, they were all killed with a single sweep of the sword.
Unknowingly, Sun Bing had arrived at the place where he was collecting red fruits. He smiled because there was a figure lying down not far away. Looking at his clothes, it was obvious that he was Li Li who had escaped.
Sure enough, just as Sun Bing had guessed, even if the opponent was an experienced hunter, under the siege of the colorful snake, he had no ability to fight back. After all, he was good at long-distance attacks, not group attacks.
Slowly walking over, I saw that Li Li's eyes were closed tightly and his face was dark. It was obvious that he had been poisoned. Even with the antidote in hand, he was lifeless.
This made Sun Bing sigh: The journey of a monk really contains countless dangers and hardships. If one step is not overcome, it means death. This is not a game. Once you die, you will never have any chance again.
After confirming that the other party was dead, Sun Bing's goal had been achieved. He even wanted to turn around and leave, but suddenly he saw a faint bulge in the other party's arms, as if there was something there.
This made Sun Bing interested, but when he looked at the other party's dark face, he still felt a little scared. Sun Bing was not afraid of monsters like colorful snakes and colorful spiders, but their poisonous nature could not be avoided even by Qi-training masters.
At that moment, he carefully stretched out his wooden sword. Not to mention, after ten years of polishing, the wooden sword was no worse than an ordinary fine iron sword. The layer of clothes was cut open like tofu, revealing the true appearance inside.
It was not something poisonous as Sun Bing imagined. Instead, it was wrapped in a brown animal skin, and there seemed to be something hidden in it.
This scene brought a smile to Sun Bing's lips. It seems that there is another income today. Although I am a little excited, I am not impulsive. In the woods surrounded by poison, I must remain absolutely calm.
The wooden sword moved slowly and found that no poison was present. Sun Bing breathed a sigh of relief. He slowly went over to pick up the animal skin and opened it without hesitation. A surprise smile appeared on his face.
He had never been so happy even when he broke through the fourth level of body tempering. There was a small bottle wrapped in the animal skin, which contained the body tempering pill. However, this bottle was not as large as Lu Jian's bottle. There were only three pills. It was better than nothing.
What made Sun Bing ecstatic was another gain. This was an object in the shape of a book, especially the four big characters "glimpse" written on the cover. It was obvious that this was the legendary footwork secret book.
